posts.sources: Text and media: Enrico Mannocci's post repository, https://github.com/Noce99/AuRoRus_Roboracer_Post (README.md and assets/, commit 361f7ad, 2026-10-28), handed over on Slack and passed on by Cedric, 2026-11-17. The body file is the README as written, with its H1 dropped (this file carries the title) and the media paths pointing at our encodes. Cedric's rulings, 2026-11-17, after reviewing the preview: the title reads 'a RoboRacer stack' (the README says 'our'); the flagship picture, here and on the news card, is a landscape crop of the Atlanta team photo; the README's own cover photo (the car and the trophy) moves into the text, after the introduction. Added by us: the Atlanta final video (Enrico's own YouTube Short, https://youtube.com/shorts/cEtLJ8aXSXk, suggested on Slack) with its caption, the two cover captions (the plate in the car photo reads UBM-Atlas; the trophy reads 2nd place Master Cup, ICRA 2026; teams.json has UBM-Atlas second) and the byline role (from his own second paragraph). DATE: 2026-11-17, the day it went live.
